title: 5th graders at Gentry Academy Middle rank 3rd for reading MCA participation in 2024-25
text:
5th graders at Gentry Academy Middle rank 3rd for reading MCA participation in 2024-25
K. R. Tan
Fifth-graders at Gentry Academy Middle recorded the third highest participation rate on the reading section of the 2024-25 MCA, according to the Minnesota Department of Education.
Out of 199 test-takers in the school, 52 were fifth-grade students participating in the reading assessment.
The test results showed that 60% of these fifth-graders achieved reading proficiency based on assessment standards.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are statewide tests designed to evaluate student achievement against Minnesota’s academic standards as well as comply with state and federal laws. Depending on their grade, students are assessed in math, reading or science. Most take the MCA, while those with special education needs who qualify may take the Alt MCA.
Data from Minnesota's Report Card indicate that overall proficiency rates on the MCA exams in Minnesota have declined compared to levels before the pandemic. For instance, statewide math proficiency has decreased by over 7% since 2019, and reading proficiency has fallen by almost 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in reading |
|---|---|---|
| 5th | 52 | 60% |
| 6th | 51 | 59% |
| 7th | 52 | 48% |
| 8th | 44 | 43% |
Details for this article were sourced from the Minnesota Department of Education. Access the original data here.
